correctness.rationale: The proof completely decomposes the traceless real symmetric quadratic space as diagonal-projection and zero-diagonal zero-row-sum sectors with dimensions n-1 and n(n-3)/2. Exact singleton/pair incidence sums give the two frame eigenvalues and vanishing cross terms. Their ratio gives one Pell equation with all positive solutions. The fourth-moment identity follows by polarization and isotropic first moments. Exact rational Gram tests substantiate finite cases; all n follow analytically.

value.rationale: The natural second harmonic band on centered constant-weight polytope vertices has two symmetry sectors, so a full spectrum and sharp rank/conditioning criteria resolve a real sampling question. Tightness reduces to Pell arithmetic and generates unbounded dimensions of equal-weight exact real projective 2-designs, including n=27,k=6 after the known n=8,k=2 case. This is an intrinsic design and reconstruction problem, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
